"This role is ACCOUNTABLE for that component" is inexpressible — and the only edge that says ownership IS the decomposition spine

*Same field report, 2026-08-03, modelling the fleet's own governance.* describe_schema{from:Component,to:Component} returns CONTAINS as the only modelled fit, hinted as *"Ownership/containment ... the axis-Y decomposition spine (see Component.level / matryoshka)"*. Using it for stewardship would make a boss contain a microservice and corrupt hierarchy_issues — one of the detectors the fleet most wants to trust. Per AGENTS.md (*"if nothing models the relationship, leave the edge out rather than asserting one that is wrong"*) the reporter left it out, and that is the right call producing the wrong outcome: the ownership matrix, their most load-bearing governance artifact, is simply silent in the graph — and a relationship nobody records is indistinguishable from one that does not exist. Consequence stated precisely: reflow2 cannot answer "who owns this blast radius", which is the question a multi-agent team most needs of an impact report. Candidate: an accountability/stewardship edge (Contributor or role → any node) explicitly NOT part of the decomposition spine and NOT a traceability edge — the way AUTHORED_BY and CLAIMS are already deliberately excluded from impact propagation, so the precedent exists in-schema. Schema touch: worth landing with [BL-185]/[BL-143] if those go, since one schema change pulls the minor bump, the upgrade doc and the foundation-migration checklist and two do not cost twice. Size M

Migrated from docs/backlog.md BL-190 on 2026-08-07 (epoch:backlog-retired). Size estimate carried from the row: M.
